subject.title: fix: report unavailable Codex runtime in model status

question: Should `openclaw models status --check` fail when the configured Codex runtime is unavailable even though an OpenClaw harness fallback can still complete a live turn?
rationale: This is an intentional change to a user-facing CLI health-check and automation contract, not only an internal diagnostic correction; the linked bug proposes the new semantics but does not establish prior maintainer approval for the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Confirm selected-runtime health semantics
options.body: Confirm that `--check` must fail for an unavailable selected Codex runtime, remove the release-owned changelog line, and merge after the normal current-head review.

options.title: Preserve fallback-health semantics
options.body: Keep the existing successful check result when fallback execution is viable and redesign the new runtime diagnostic as non-failing status information.

recommendation.title: Confirm selected-runtime health semantics
recommendation.body: Confirm that `--check` must fail for an unavailable selected Codex runtime, remove the release-owned changelog line, and merge after the normal current-head review.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the reproduction, expected CLI contract, and current implementation, making them the clearest available routing contact for the intended semantics.
